test_add_remove_favorites.title: Verify adding a camera to favorites, seeing it in the panel, and removing it.

steps.action: Log in to the application with valid credentials
steps.expected: User is logged in and default page loads
Camera Favorite page loads without errors

steps.action: Verify the page displays any existing items
steps.expected: Page content loads (list, table, or empty state)

steps.action: Click the create/add button for adding and removing a camera from favorites panel
Verify all required form fields are present and empty/default
steps.expected: Form fields are displayed with correct labels and placeholders

steps.action: Fill in all required fields with valid test data
steps.expected: All fields accept the input without errors

steps.action: Fill in any optional fields if applicable
Review the filled form for correctness
steps.expected: All entered data is displayed correctly in the form
Form is submitted and a success message or indicator appears

steps.action: Verify the newly created adding and removing a camera from favorites panel appears in the list or view
steps.expected: The new adding and removing a camera from favorites panel is visible with the correct data

steps.action: Verify no duplicate entries were created
steps.expected: Only one instance of the new adding and removing a camera from favorites panel exists
